source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の改修用。ユーザーが別に生成した 1254x1254 の画像。1 枚の絵のマスは crop で余白 (白い背景や壁) を切り落とす
style: Small everyday fixtures on the corridor walls of a space-habitat apartment block. Each cell is ONE item seen exactly straight on, filling the cell, flat even light, no shadows, no readable text (blank or abstract labels only).

cells.name: mg-nameplate
cells.prompt: An apartment nameplate above an intercom button panel, mounted on a wall, blank plate.

cells.name: mg-mailboxes
cells.prompt: A bank of grey metal apartment mailboxes, rows of small doors with number plates (blank).

cells.name: mg-meterbox
cells.prompt: A utility meter box with a small glass window showing electric and water meters.

cells.name: mg-firehose
cells.prompt: A red fire hose cabinet with a glass door, the coiled hose visible inside, a red lamp on top.

cells.name: mg-exit-sign
cells.prompt: A green emergency exit sign: a white running figure pictogram and an arrow, no words.

cells.name: mg-address
cells.prompt: A blue enamel address plate with white abstract symbols, slightly worn edges.

cells.name: mg-noticeboard
cells.prompt: A cork notice board with pinned community notices, a lost-cat flyer, a calendar and photos (no readable text).

cells.name: mg-posters
cells.prompt: Three community posters side by side: a festival, a clean-up day and a health check, colourful illustrations, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-trash-sign
cells.prompt: A garbage sorting sign with coloured icons for burnable, plastic, cans and paper, no words.
